b2-09-01.title: Communicative Challenge: No Matter What
b2-09-01.scenario: At the tram terminus the clerk explains once more that no tram is running. The passenger wants to wait anyway. You are the passenger and answer.
b2-09-01.prompt: Tell the clerk that you will wait, whatever he says.
cues: Say that you will wait, whatever the clerk says
Say that you will not go home, however long it takes
b2-09-01.target: Bármit mond is, én itt várok. Bármennyire sokáig tart is, nem megyek haza.
b2-09-01.english: Whatever you say, I will wait here. However long it takes, I am not going home.
b2-09-01.canDo: I can form universal concessive clauses with bárki, bármi, bárhol, bárhogyan, and bármennyire is.

b2-09-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Either Way
b2-09-02.scenario: The passenger asks the clerk whether he may close the ticket window if the passenger goes home. You are the clerk and explain the rule.
b2-09-02.prompt: Tell the passenger that the window must stay open in both cases.
cues: Say that it makes no difference whether the passenger stays or goes home
Say that the window must stay open
b2-09-02.target: Akár marad az utas, akár hazamegy, a pénztárnak nyitva kell maradnia.
b2-09-02.english: Whether the passenger stays or goes home, the ticket window must stay open.
b2-09-02.canDo: I can construct exhaustive binary concessions using akár... akár... ('whether... or...').

b2-09-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Anyone and Not Just Anyone
b2-09-03.scenario: The passenger asks the clerk whether the rule is only for him. You are the clerk and answer.
b2-09-03.prompt: Tell the passenger who gets the same answer and who sits at this window.
cues: Say that everyone who comes gets the same answer
Say that not just anybody sits at this window
b2-09-03.target: Bárki jön ide, ugyanazt a választ kapja. Nem akárki ül ebben az ablakban.
b2-09-03.english: Whoever comes here gets the same answer. Not just anybody sits at this window.
b2-09-03.canDo: I can distinguish the stylistic and logical nuances between bár- and akár- free-choice pronouns.

b2-09-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Regardless of the Errand
b2-09-04.scenario: The passenger says he has a very urgent errand in the city. You are the clerk and answer him politely.
b2-09-04.prompt: Tell the passenger that his urgent errand changes nothing.
cues: Say that the rule is valid whatever the passenger's errand
Say that it makes no difference whether he stays or goes home
b2-09-04.target: Sajnálom, de a szabály érvényes, függetlenül attól, hogy önnek milyen sürgős dolga van. Mindegy, hogy marad-e, vagy hazamegy.
b2-09-04.english: I am sorry, but the rule is valid, regardless of how urgent your business is. It makes no difference whether you stay or go home.
b2-09-04.canDo: I can express logical independence using függetlenül attól, hogy... and tekintet nélkül arra, hogy....

b2-09-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Clerk's Argument
b2-09-05.scenario: The clerk has just explained why the ticket window can never close. The passenger notices the flaw. You are the passenger and answer.
b2-09-05.prompt: Tell the clerk that his argument contradicts itself.
cues: Grant that the argument seems consistent
Say that the window breaks the rule whether it is closed or open
b2-09-05.target: Bármennyire következetes is az érvelése, saját magának mond ellent. Akár bezárja a pénztárt, akár nyitva hagyja, megszegi a szabályzatot.
b2-09-05.english: However consistent your argument is, it contradicts itself. Whether you close the ticket window or leave it open, you break the regulations.
b2-09-05.canDo: I can deconstruct a flawed or circular argument using bár-... is, akár... akár..., and tekintet nélkül arra, hogy.

b2-09-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Once More at the Window
b2-09-consolidation.scenario: At the terminus the clerk explains for the last time why there is no ticket. You are the passenger and reply.
b2-09-consolidation.prompt: Tell the clerk that his explanations change nothing for you.
cues: Say that you do not understand, however he explains it
Say that you will wait here, whatever he says
b2-09-consolidation.target: Bárhogyan magyarázza is, nem értem. Bármit mond is, én itt várok.
b2-09-consolidation.english: However you explain it, I do not understand. Whatever you say, I will wait here.
b2-09-consolidation.canDo: I can form universal concessive clauses with bárki, bármi, bárhogyan, and bármennyire is.
